unified_annotations.annotation_text: This SoA shows visits and procedures unique to the intervention-specific appendix (ISA) H0P-MC-OA01 (OA01) for LY3016859. Please refer to master protocol H0P-MC-CPMP (CPMP) and the osteoarthritis (OA) disease-state addendum (DSA) H0P-MC-CPMP(1) SoAs for additional information.
Minimal interval between 2 doses cannot be shorter than 11 days.
Targeted exam for skin, eyes, mouth, lungs and GI tract should be performed at each visit, in addition to any symptom driven exam.
Full physical exam should be performed at Visit 803 or ED.
Includes respiratory rate, blood pressure, temperature and pulse rate.
All vital signs are collected before study intervention infusion on V3-6.

1 hour IV administration
The timing between randomization and the first IV infusion may be up to, but not longer than 2 business days to reduce participant burden.
If the participant discontinues after V801, this assessment is not needed for ED per the CPMP SoA.
Use C-SSRS Since Last Visit version.
Required if triggered by the Self-Harm Supplement Form per instructions.
For all premenopausal females or postmenopausal females <50 years of age
V3-V6: collect samples before IV infusion starts and within 15 minutes after IV infusion is complete.
V7 – V803: single sample collected at any time.
Obtain PK samples from opposite arm used for IV infusion. Record date and time of collection.
V3-6: collect sample before IV infusion starts
V3-6: collect sample before IV infusion starts.
V7-V803: single sample collected at any time to match PK.

review_items.call_made: The note 'If the participant discontinues after V801, this assessment is not needed for ED per the CPMP SoA.' is bound to the activity rows (Rescue medication usage reporting, NRS, PGI, WOMAC). It states a condition on the ED mark of the master (CPMP) SoA; this table has no ED mark on these rows, so there is no cell here for it to bind to.
review_items.alternative: Bind it to the empty ED cell (column 10) of each row, or record the location as unresolved because its target is in another document.

review_items.call_made: 'V3-6: collect sample before IV infusion starts' (ADA row) and the same sentence with a final period (Epiregulin row) are bound to the marked cells V3, V4, V5 only; neither row has a mark at V6, although the note names V3-6.
review_items.alternative: Bind each note to the whole row, or to V3-V6 including the unmarked V6 cell.
